serverNotReady.where: Recordings (upload, playback): Error toast/message when the server's database connection is not initialised (rare, transient).

authRequired.where: Recording playback: error when the listener is not signed in

invalidRecordingId.where: Recording playback: error when the recording link has no id
invalidRecordingId.context: 'recording' = a reference audio recording of a song

recordingNotFound.where: Recording playback: error when the recording was deleted

noStoredFile.where: Recording playback: error when the recording entry has no audio file

fileNotFound.where: Recording playback: error when the audio file is missing from storage

fileUnavailable.where: Recording playback: error when the audio file could not be downloaded (temporary)

leadersOnly.where: Song recordings: error toast when a musician who is not a band leader tries to upload a recording

noFileProvided.where: Song recordings upload: error when no audio file was attached

songIdRequired.where: Song recordings upload: error when the upload did not say which song it belongs to (developer error)

audioOnly.where: Song recordings upload: error when the chosen file is not audio
audioOnly.context: Keep the file extensions in the parentheses as written

fileTooLarge.where: Song recordings upload: error when the audio file is too big
fileTooLarge.context: {maxMb} is a number of megabytes (25); 'MB' is the unit
